title: Place the complete 4x4 segmented NoC fabric
hypothesis: A compact endpoint-boundary harness can keep every payload bit, metadata field, VC FIFO, route branch, router instance, and inter-router link observable while allowing the complete 4x4 fabric to be placed as a macro without the artificial pin pressure of exposing all 16 endpoint buses.

direct_comparison.primary_question: How much timing, area, power, congestion, and synthesis complexity is added when the exact 16-router mesh and its links are placed together instead of composing one-router PPA?
include: clock-tree and routed-wire effects from aggregate placement

expected_benefit: replace the single-router-times-instance-count area floor with aggregate physical evidence
measure mesh wiring, congestion, buffering, and clock-distribution effects
bound whether the 4x4 topology remains physically plausible before Llama7B reranking
risks: the first point uses a deliberately loose 3.2 mm square die feasibility envelope and does not optimize die size
source and observation boundary registers add disclosed harness overhead
hierarchical synthesis may retain unobserved performance counters inside kept router modules; retained counter cost must be audited rather than assumed
the 16-router design may cross the known Yosys/OpenROAD runtime frontier

required_evaluations.objective: Measure first-pass Nangate45 hierarchical physical feasibility for the complete compact-boundary 4x4 segmented mesh.
